native.scope: Real Windows Obsidian 1.13.7, OS FileShare.Read lock, owned process SIGKILL/restarts, unchanged production main.js and local official-origin fixtures. Fast answer durably saved before peers; recovery archive survives repeated failed restart; explicit restore preserves capture IDs and human document edits; corrupt journal stays byte-identical while saved answers readable; dispatch interruption becomes unknown with staged peers paused and no reopened guests.

design: Recovery directory is stable per device/folder within .nand/recovery/drafts, each runtime has a UUID snapshot. New failed initialization cannot overwrite a prior captured-answer snapshot. Reader lists only this directory and requires explicit selection.

Explicit preview validates baseline/draft and fresh current documents. Restore uses deletion-aware three-way merge and fresh preview comparison; no automatic send. Conflicts stay visible and recoverable answers remain readable/copyable.
Initial journal error should retain an explicit local-read/recovery entry rather than making saved answers inaccessible. Damaged owned Markdown is not overwritten by a default empty object.
